notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 connection and callback-control surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, endpoint, callback configuration, and optional standard RtiConfiguration inputs. It verifies all four connect overloads, unsupported callback-model rejection, pre-connect service boundaries, duplicate-connect rejection, callback enable/disable controls, empty-queue callback servicing, disconnect, and reconnect. The configuration-overload case explicitly passes empty configurationName, rtiAddress, and additionalSettings strings and requires Connect to succeed using default local settings (§12.12.5). It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, or FOM behavior, nor does it claim independent-provider conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador connect, disconnect, callback controls, and FederateAmbassador callback model
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador connection and callback declarations
